description: The social proof band. One to six quotes, each with an optional real rating drawn by RatingMark. Variants: grid, single.
docs: `rating` is optional and is never defaulted. A default of 5 would invent a five-star review every time a caller omitted the field. Omit it and no mark is drawn.
